Mini world change in Tiquanda: {creature:Hunter|Hunters} and {wiki:Dworcs|Dworcs} fight over some sacred grounds in the jungle. Depending on the day, you find at the site a {wiki:Hunter Camp|Hunter Camp} with Hunters and Poachers, or a {wiki:Dworc Camp|Dworc Camp} dominated by Dworcs, and perhaps the boss of the winning clan: {creature:Arthom the Hunter} or {creature:Oodok Witchmaster}.
